body:
What

Switches that hide or show parts of the screen.

How
  • Timer cards ({{F:cooking-timers}}): hide or show the stack.
  • Pantry gauge ({{F:pantry-gauge}}): hide or show the gauge.
Depends On

{{F:settings-menu}}.1, {{F:pantry-gauge}} (the gauge) and {{F:cooking-timers}} (the cards).
name: Display Switches for Photos, Units and Timers
